title: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance | Ankit Maheshwari (Innovaccer)
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (31 mins) | 🎙️ Ankit Maheshwari (CTO, Innovaccer) walks me through the OpenClaw Jarvis he runs on a Mac Mini to clear every 1% annoyance in his life
summary: Ankit Maheshwari , the CTO of Innovaccer, walks me through the OpenClaw Jarvis he still runs on a Mac Mini. He started with the approvals that were making him the bottleneck at work, then kept going until the same system was ordering his lunch, calling coworkers who haven’t responded on Slack, negotiating restaurant reservations, and turning on the AC before he gets home.
takeaways: We get into the soul files and guardrails that make it trustworthy, why he split voice calling into its own subagent, and why he’s pressure-testing GLM 5.3 Flash against a $500-to-$600-a-month Anthropic bill.
